verdict.rationale: Bun ships strong, well-documented defaults against lifecycle-script supply-chain attacks: it does not execute arbitrary postinstall/lifecycle scripts unless a package is explicitly added to `trustedDependencies`, which platform engineers can lock down in package.json (bun-docs-4, bun-docs-19, bun-docs-53). Bun also offers `bun audit` for vulnerability scanning (bun-docs-6, bun-docs-7). However, there is no evidence of a 'minimum release age' enforcement feature or any other configurable install-blocking policy engine that platform teams could turn on. Missing for 10: documented minimum-release-age/publish-age gating, org-wide policy enforcement mechanism, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these protections in practice.
